name: net_prologue_mansion_hall_friend_down
description: VUH-2866 downed variant of net_prologue_mansion_hall.json (ordering: VUH-2869). Both seats fight wave 1 until two of its four Dusks are dead, so wave 2 cannot have started. Then the friend is downed through the DownedSpike fixture channel's Kill (KH2COOP_DOWNED_SPIKE_FIXTURE=1, a test channel product play never maps; the downing itself is the product's logical downing), and the run waits until both seats name that fresh episode. Only then does the other seat finish wave 1 and fight wave 2 alone. downed_wave_order (tools/scenario/downed_order.py) must show, in each seat's own log, the episode before the first wave-2 (309) line, and the downed seat's hold end, revive or return for that episode. Both seats then load Axel I's room. Rehearsal save. No save.

steps.message: the rehearsal save must load Twilight Town on both seats

steps.expr: log_count('[prologue] unpinned start', 0) > 0 and log_count('[prologue] unpinned start', 1) > 0
log_count('control released at=02/13 evt=134 site=tt19-134', 0) > 0 and log_count('control released at=02/13 evt=134 site=tt19-134', 1) > 0
all(len([a for a in actors(i) if a['name']=='P_EX110']) == 2 for i in (0, 1))
steps.message: both seats must hold both Roxases at tt19-134

steps.expr: not any(saved['before_down']['waveStarted']) and log_count('[enemysync] host death epoch', 0) - saved['deaths_before'] < 4
steps.message: wave 2 had already started, or wave 1 was over, before the forced downing: this run cannot prove the variant

steps.expr: downed_wave_order(1, 'control released at=02/13 evt=134 site=tt19-134')['episodeSeen'] == [True, True]

steps.message: wave 2 started before both seats knew the forced episode

steps.expr: {'hostDeaths': log_count('[enemysync] host death epoch', 0) - saved['deaths_before'], 'deathWithoutBinding': log_count('death-without-continuous-binding', 1), 'unmatched': [m['u'] for m in log_matches(r'\[statehash\] role=client .* unmatched=(?P<u>\d+)', 1)][-1:], 'fullPartyDown': log_count('[downed] full party down', 0)}
saved['combat']['hostDeaths'] >= 6 and saved['combat']['deathWithoutBinding'] == 0 and saved['combat']['unmatched'][-1:] in ([], ['0'])
steps.message: wave 2 must appear and die on both seats while the friend is down
the forced episode must precede wave 2 on both seats and end on the downed seat (see saved order.why)

steps.expr: [log_count('[mission-mirror] host end trap=mission_complete', 0), log_count('client end like the host file=TT19_MS602.bar trap=mission_complete', 1) + log_count('client end observed file=TT19_MS602.bar path=native-local replays=0', 1)]

steps.message: one host mission end, followed exactly once, and never a full-party down
